Did Mamdani Force Cancellation of Macy’s Thanksgiving Parade?

Both the Left and Islam hate Thanksgiving.

November 26, 2026 by Daniel Greenfield 12 Comments

Newsletter
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:12
Instaread

Zohran Mamdani has some interesting approaches to parades. He joined the Pakistani celebration of its genocidal founding, but rejected the Italian, Jewish and Polish parades.

Now the Macy’s Thanksgiving parade, a national staple, has been canceled for the first time in history.

Officially it’s been postponed to Saturday due to weather, but I can tell you as a New Yorker that this is a parade that people fly into town to be a part of. Even assuming that it’s allowed to go forward on Saturday (when a lot of Jews conveniently won’t be able to take part), the turnout will be less and a bunch of participants will no longer be there to take part or to watch.

The Macy’s Thanksgiving Parade has been around for a century and New York City has had plenty of weather in that time. Including wind and rain. Sometimes keeping the parade going is a challenge, but it’s a Thanksgiving parade and so it happens on Thanksgiving.

Organizers had reportedly wanted to go on and even began inflating the balloons, but then pulled back and then issued a statement saying that due to “the safety of our participants and spectators is our top priority, and after close consultation with our City and agency partners, we have made the decision to move this year’s celebration.”

That sounds like the Mamdani people forced the cancelation of the Thanksgiving Parade.

Now I’m not a meteorologist, so I can’t speak to the weather, but hostility to Thanksgiving is a staple of not just Mamdani’s Islamic religion, which despises Christianity as an infidel religion and seeks to thwart all its practices, much as is the case in his Pakistani homeland, but his leftist movement has also been anti-Thanksgiving. Boston City Council members recently passed a resolution naming Thanksgiving as a National Day of Mourning and a number of DSA figures and candidates have expressed hostility towards the traditional American holiday.

Maybe the Macy’s Thanksgiving parade cancelation was legitimate and maybe it was Mamdani’s hatred once again coming out. Either way, under Mamdani, the Macy’s Thanksgiving parade has been shut down due to ‘weather’ for the first time in history.
